app/strings_run_limits.xml.run_limits_steps_background_desc_set: Applies to runs you did not start yourself — a trigger, a schedule, the Quick Settings tile, or another app.
app/strings_run_limits.xml.run_limits_steps_desc: How many steps a run may take before it stops. One step is one node execution.
app/strings_run_limits.xml.run_limits_tokens_background_desc: Runs you did not start yourself get a lower token limit by default, because no one is watching them finish.
app/strings_run_limits.xml.run_limits_tokens_desc: How many tokens a run may send and receive in total.
app/strings_run_limits.xml.run_notice_looks_stuck: This run looks stuck — the same step keeps repeating. It will stop if nothing changes.
app/strings_run_limits.xml.run_notice_soft_steps: Nearing the step limit: %1$,d of %2$,d steps used.
app/strings_run_limits.xml.run_notice_soft_tokens: Nearing the token limit: %1$,d of %2$,d tokens used.
app/strings_run_limits.xml.run_outcome_chat_cancelled: This run was stopped before it could answer.
app/strings_run_limits.xml.run_outcome_chat_failed: This run stopped before it could answer.
app/strings_run_limits.xml.run_outcome_chat_failed_with_diagnostic: This run stopped before it could answer: %1$s
app/strings_run_limits.xml.run_outcome_chat_interrupted: This run was interrupted and did not finish.
app/strings_run_limits.xml.run_termination_banner_graph_changed: The pipeline changed while this run was paused.
app/strings_run_limits.xml.run_termination_banner_no_progress: Stopped: the run was not getting anywhere.
app/strings_run_limits.xml.run_termination_banner_not_resumable: This run could not be picked up again.
app/strings_run_limits.xml.run_termination_banner_process_died: The app stopped while this run was working.
app/strings_run_limits.xml.run_termination_banner_step_ceiling: Stopped by a safety limit — used %1$,d of %2$,d steps.
app/strings_run_limits.xml.run_termination_banner_token_ceiling: Stopped by a safety limit — used %1$,d of %2$,d tokens.
app/strings_run_limits.xml.run_termination_body_discarded: It ended at your request, and nothing was left running.
app/strings_run_limits.xml.run_termination_body_graph_changed: This run was built on the earlier version of the pipeline, so it could not pick up where it left off. Running it again uses the current version.
app/strings_run_limits.xml.run_termination_body_hitl_expired: A step needed your approval and the waiting window closed before an answer arrived.
app/strings_run_limits.xml.run_termination_body_no_progress: The same work kept repeating without moving the task forward, so the run was ended.
app/strings_run_limits.xml.run_termination_body_not_resumable: Your answer arrived, but the run had already been closed out. Running it again starts from the beginning.
app/strings_run_limits.xml.run_termination_body_process_died: The run was found unfinished at the next start and closed out. Nothing was left half-running.
app/strings_run_limits.xml.run_termination_body_run_stalled: The task stopped responding and was ended so other messages can run. A step it was waiting on — most often an external tool — never answered.
app/strings_run_limits.xml.run_termination_body_step_ceiling: This run used all the steps it was allowed. Raise the step limit, or split the work into smaller runs.
app/strings_run_limits.xml.run_termination_body_token_ceiling: This run used all the tokens it was allowed. Raise the token limit, or ask for something narrower.
app/strings_run_limits.xml.run_termination_notification_body_step_c: “%1$s” stopped at its step limit, after %2$,d steps.
app/strings_run_limits.xml.run_termination_notification_body_token_: “%1$s” stopped at its token limit, after %2$,d tokens.
app/strings_run_limits.xml.run_termination_title_graph_changed: The pipeline changed while this run was paused
app/strings_run_limits.xml.run_termination_title_no_progress: Stopped: the run was not getting anywhere
app/strings_run_limits.xml.run_termination_title_not_resumable: This run could not be picked up again
app/strings_run_limits.xml.run_termination_title_process_died: The app stopped while this run was working

app/strings_settings.xml.about_privacy_policy_body: All inference and memory live on-device by default. Crash reporting is opt-in. API keys are stored in the Android Keystore. No analytics SDKs are bundled.
app/strings_settings.xml.about_tagline: An on-device AI agent for Android
app/strings_settings.xml.help_doc_cookbook_desc: Worked pipelines to copy, and the generated reference for every node type.
app/strings_settings.xml.help_doc_external_automation_desc: Driving the agent from Tasker, adb or another app on the device.
app/strings_settings.xml.help_doc_faq_desc: Short answers, each one pointing at the screen where you actually do the thing.
app/strings_settings.xml.help_doc_troubleshooting_desc: Fixes for the failures that have names: the model will not load, a background run dies, your data cannot be unlocked at startup.
app/strings_settings.xml.help_doc_user_guide_desc: The long form: every screen and every flow, with a search box that works.
app/strings_settings.xml.help_offline_bar: That link is on the web. No network right now.
app/strings_settings.xml.help_offline_body: %1$s is on the web and needs one. Troubleshooting and FAQ are on this device and open without it.
app/strings_settings.xml.help_reader_error_body: The file shipped with the app is unreadable. Reinstalling replaces it. The same document is on the web, unchanged.
app/strings_settings.xml.model_download_checksum_mismatch: The downloaded file did not match the checksum Hugging Face published for it, so it was deleted. Download it again.
app/strings_settings.xml.model_download_paused_time_limit: Download paused: Android limits how long a download can run in the background. Start it again to continue from where it stopped.
app/strings_settings.xml.notifications_agent_foreground_channel_d: Shows a status while the agent is actively working; dismissed automatically when it finishes.
app/strings_settings.xml.notifications_model_download_mismatch_te: %1$s did not match the checksum Hugging Face published for it, so it was deleted. Download it again in the app.
app/strings_settings.xml.notifications_model_download_paused_text: %1$s: Android limits how long a download can run in the background. Start it again in the app to continue from where it stopped.
app/strings_settings.xml.notifications_scheduled_running_body: Agent is working in the background…
app/strings_settings.xml.notifications_trigger_stale_body: “%1$s” has not been checked since %2$s. Some phones pause background work to save battery.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_address_error_not_url: Not an address. It starts with http:// or https://.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_address_hint_v1: Include /v1 — most servers serve the OpenAI API under it.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_address_refused_block_host: Block network from local model is on, so only this device and private IP addresses are allowed. %1$s is a host name: use the server’s IP address, or turn the setting off in Settings → Tools & workspace.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_address_refused_block_ip: Block network from local model is on, so only this device and private IP addresses are allowed, and %1$s is a public address. Use a private one, or turn the setting off in Settings → Tools & workspace.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_address_refused_public_http: %1$s is on the public internet, and http:// would send your prompts unencrypted. Use https://.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_cleartext_consent_body: Traffic to %1$s is not encrypted. Anyone on the same network can read what you send. Approve it only if this address is a machine you trust on your own network.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_cloud_retry_attempts_hint: How many times one failed call is tried again before it gives up. Set it to 1 and a failure is reported immediately.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_cloud_retry_delay_hint: The wait before the first retry; each further one waits longer. Short reacts faster, long is kinder to a rate limit.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_cloud_retry_hint: Applies to every cloud provider and cloud embeddings. Rate limits and server errors are retried, after the wait the provider asks for; a bad key never is.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_destructive_clear_memory_body: This deletes every memory chunk on this device — including pinned entries. The action cannot be undone.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_destructive_reset_body: This restores all tunable settings to their recommended defaults. Your chats, long-term memory, pipelines, presets, skills, connections, custom prompts and API keys are left untouched.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_external_pipeline_unbound: Not set — every request is refused
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_field_system_prompt_prefix: Be concise. Prefer bullet points over prose. Use $DATE for any date reference and $LANG for the user's language.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_key_hint_compat: Leave empty if the server has none. Sent as a Bearer token.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_memory_import_dialog_body: This file contains %1$d memory chunks. Choose how to apply them.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_memory_import_pins_warning: %1$d of these chunks were pinned in the file. Pins are not imported — pin the ones you want again on the Memory screen.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_memory_import_provider_warning: Memory was exported with embedding provider "%1$s", which differs from the one you're using. Embeddings will be re-computed in the background after import.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_memory_import_reembed_note: Embeddings are being re-computed in the background.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_memory_import_schema_warning: This file was written by a different app version. Some data may not import cleanly.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_memory_import_too_large: This file is larger than %1$s, the most this device can import at once.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_memory_reembed_banner: Embeddings were created with a different provider — re-embed recommended
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_memory_validation_compaction_ag: Compaction age must be between %1$d and %2$d days.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_memory_validation_compression_t: Compression threshold must be between %1$d and %2$d tokens.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_memory_validation_half_life: Half-life must be between %1$d and %2$d days.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_memory_validation_live_window: Live window must be between %1$d and %2$d messages.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_memory_validation_max_chunks: Max chunks must be between %1$d and %2$d.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_model_note_before_test: Type the id, or run Test to choose from the server’s list.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_model_note_no_list: This server sent no model list. Type the id it serves.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_model_note_not_offered: %1$s is no longer offered — runs use %2$s. Choose a model above.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_provider_picker_compat_desc: vLLM, LM Studio, llama.cpp, or any server that speaks the OpenAI API.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_restart_required_message: This change needs a restart to take effect.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_row_inference_backend_subtitle: %1$s · falls back to CPU if it fails to start.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_system_instructions_helper: Prepended to every system prompt the agent sends.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_test_backend_failure_file_missi: The model file is not on the device. Download it again.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_test_disabled_cleartext: Approve the unencrypted connection above to test.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_test_disabled_no_address: Enter the server address to test.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_test_disabled_no_key: Enter the API key to test.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_test_disabled_no_url: Enter the server URL to test.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_test_disabled_refused_address: This address is not allowed. The reason is above.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_test_failed_conn_refused: %1$s refused the connection. Check that the server is running and listening on that port.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_test_failed_dns: Can’t find %1$s. Check the spelling of the address.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_test_failed_handshake: %1$s accepted the connection but did not finish the MCP handshake in %2$d s. Check that the URL is the server’s MCP endpoint.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_test_failed_key_hosted: Key rejected (%1$d). Paste it again, or make a new one in your %2$s account.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_test_failed_key_missing: The server wants a key (%1$d). Enter it under API key.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_test_failed_key_own: Key rejected (%1$d). Check the key the server expects.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_test_failed_mcp_auth: Credentials rejected (%1$d). Check the token under Authentication.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_test_failed_no_list: The server answered, but not with a model list.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_test_failed_not_found: Nothing at %1$s (404). Most servers need the address to end in /v1.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_test_failed_not_mcp: %1$s answered, but not as an MCP server. Check the path: it is often /mcp or /sse.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_test_failed_offline: Can’t reach %1$s. Check that this phone is online, then test again.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_test_failed_other: Unexpected answer (%1$d): “%2$s”. Check that the address is the API, not a web page — or type the model id below.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_test_failed_other_no_body: Unexpected answer (%1$d). Check that the address is the API, not a web page — or type the model id below.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_test_failed_rate: Rate limited. %1$s asked to wait %2$d s. Test again after that.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_test_failed_rate_no_wait: Rate limited by %1$s. Test again in a minute.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_test_failed_server_hosted: Server error (%1$d) at %2$s. The problem is on their side: test again in a few minutes.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_test_failed_server_own: Server error (%1$d). The server answered and then failed: check its log, then test again.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_test_failed_silence: %1$s connected, then sent nothing for %2$d s. Restart the server, then test again.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_test_failed_timeout: No answer from %1$s in %2$d s. Check that it is running and reachable from this phone.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_test_idle_mcp: Connects with the values above and lists the tools. Saves nothing.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_test_idle_provider: Asks for the model list. Sends no prompt and spends no tokens.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_test_ok_zero: Connected · no models. The server is up but serves none yet: load one on it, then test again.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_test_refused_block_host: Block network from local model allows only this device and private IP addresses, and %1$s is neither. Use the server’s IP, or change the setting in Settings → Tools & workspace.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_test_refused_block_hosted: Block network from local model is on, and %1$s is on the internet. To use it, turn the setting off in Settings → Tools & workspace.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_test_refused_public_http: %1$s is on the public internet and the address is unencrypted. Use https://.
app/strings_settings.xml.settings_usage_reset_body: This permanently clears every on-device usage count. It does not change the recording setting.

app/strings_settings_help.xml.settings_help_active_embedding_provider_: The model that turns text into the numbers memory search compares. Change it and recall stays poor until you re-embed by hand.
app/strings_settings_help.xml.settings_help_audio_max_duration_sec: Recording stops on its own at this point and sends what it has.
app/strings_settings_help.xml.settings_help_auto_extract_enabled: On, durable facts from your chats — names, preferences, project details — are saved and reused later.
app/strings_settings_help.xml.settings_help_background_approval_window: How long a background run waits for you to approve a tool call. Unanswered past it, the run ends rather than waiting forever.
app/strings_settings_help.xml.settings_help_block_destructive_tools: On, a destructive tool call is refused outright rather than offered for approval, and the run sees it as a failed call.
app/strings_settings_help.xml.settings_help_block_network_from_local_m: On, no cloud model and no Wikipedia lookup runs, memory search included. Ollama answers only at localhost or a private IP, never by name.
app/strings_settings_help.xml.settings_help_chat_history_compression_e: Long threads are summarised past the live window, so the agent keeps the gist instead of forgetting the start.
app/strings_settings_help.xml.settings_help_chat_history_compression_t: How large a thread grows before everything past the live window is summarised. Lower compresses sooner and keeps less wording.
app/strings_settings_help.xml.settings_help_chat_history_live_window_s: How many recent messages stay word-for-word after a thread is summarised. Anything older survives only as the summary.
app/strings_settings_help.xml.settings_help_crash_reporting_enabled: Off, nothing leaves the device. On, crashes plus warning and error log lines go out — never your messages, prompts or keys.
app/strings_settings_help.xml.settings_help_external_automation_enable: Other apps on this device can start a run — Tasker, MacroDroid, adb. Off, those requests are refused and nothing is sent back.
app/strings_settings_help.xml.settings_help_external_automation_pipeli: The only pipeline an outside app may start. Nothing else can be named in the request, whatever it asks for.
app/strings_settings_help.xml.settings_help_http_tool_max_response_byt: How much of a web response or MCP result the app keeps. Past it the text is cut and marked. It bounds memory, not the context.
app/strings_settings_help.xml.settings_help_language: The language of the app's screens. What a model reads stays in English: system prompts, tool descriptions and tool results.
app/strings_settings_help.xml.settings_help_local_model_backend: Which chip runs the on-device model. GPU is faster where it works; if it fails to start, the app runs on CPU.
app/strings_settings_help.xml.settings_help_max_context_length: The working window of the on-device model. Larger holds more at once and runs slower; cloud models use their own window.
app/strings_settings_help.xml.settings_help_max_memory_chunks: The ceiling on stored pieces. Reaching it starts a compaction pass, so it does nothing at all while compaction is switched off.
app/strings_settings_help.xml.settings_help_memory_actions: Re-embed rebuilds every vector for the current model. Stay on this screen while it runs, and expect poor recall until it finishes.
app/strings_settings_help.xml.settings_help_memory_compaction_age_days: How old a memory must be before compaction may merge it. Fresher facts keep their exact wording until they pass it.
app/strings_settings_help.xml.settings_help_memory_compaction_enabled: Old memories get merged into shorter summaries once there are many. Frees room; loses the exact wording.
app/strings_settings_help.xml.settings_help_memory_recency_half_life_d: How fast old memories lose to new ones when both match. Short favours this week; long treats everything as current.
app/strings_settings_help.xml.settings_help_memory_search_threshold: Higher recalls only close matches, so less is pulled in; lower recalls more, including memories that miss the point.
app/strings_settings_help.xml.settings_help_memory_search_top_k: How many memories are pulled into a reply at most. More context, slower start, and more room for noise.
app/strings_settings_help.xml.settings_help_memory_summary_default_lim: How many recent memories the $MEMORY_SUMMARY prompt variable lists. Pipelines that do not use that variable are unaffected.
app/strings_settings_help.xml.settings_help_pipeline_max_nesting_depth: How many levels of sub-pipeline a run may descend into before it is refused. Deeper composes more; shallow fails a runaway sooner.
app/strings_settings_help.xml.settings_help_quick_settings_tile_pipeli: Which pipeline the Quick Settings tile runs when you tap it from the notification shade.
app/strings_settings_help.xml.settings_help_resume_max_age_hours: How stale a parked run may be and still resume. Past it the run is dropped, because its gathered context no longer holds.
app/strings_settings_help.xml.settings_help_scheduled_task_notificatio: A notification arrives when a scheduled task finishes or fails, so a background result does not wait for you to open the app.
app/strings_settings_help.xml.settings_help_share_reuse_session: On, every share lands in one Shared chat. Off, each share opens its own, so the chat list grows with each one.
app/strings_settings_help.xml.settings_help_share_target_pipeline_id: Which pipeline runs when you share text or a link into the app from somewhere else.
app/strings_settings_help.xml.settings_help_structured_output_max_repa: When a model answers in the wrong shape, how many times it is shown its own output and asked again before the node gives up.
app/strings_settings_help.xml.settings_help_system_prompt_prefix: Goes in front of every Local LLM, Cloud and Skill step, wherever it runs — chats, triggers, background. Other node types skip it.
app/strings_settings_help.xml.settings_help_temperature: Higher values make the on-device model's answers more varied and surprising; lower values keep them predictable.
app/strings_settings_help.xml.settings_help_tool_approval_policy: Which tool calls stop and wait for your approval. Never lets read-only and sensitive ones through; destructive ones still ask.
app/strings_settings_help.xml.settings_help_tool_call_timeout_ms: How long a run waits for you to approve a tool call before it parks and asks again later. It does not bound the call itself.
app/strings_settings_help.xml.settings_help_top_k: Caps how many candidate words the on-device model may choose between at each step. Smaller keeps it on the obvious choice.
app/strings_settings_help.xml.settings_help_top_p: Narrows each step to the likeliest words that together reach this share of the probability. Lower is safer, higher roams.
app/strings_settings_help.xml.settings_help_trace_retention_max_age_da: How long a trace is kept before it is dropped, whatever the per-chat count. Bounds what accumulates on disk.
app/strings_settings_help.xml.settings_help_trace_retention_runs_per_s: How many past runs keep their step-by-step trace in a chat. Older traces are dropped; the messages themselves stay.
app/strings_settings_help.xml.settings_help_verbose_memory_logging_ena: Adds each recalled memory, text included, to the console — useful when answers cite the wrong thing, and revealing on a shared screen.
app/strings_settings_help.xml.settings_help_workspace_max_file_size_by: The largest single file the workspace accepts, for both writing one and reading one whole.
app/strings_settings_help.xml.settings_help_workspace_max_total_bytes: How much device storage the whole workspace may hold. A write that would push past it is refused rather than trimmed.
app/strings_settings_help.xml.settings_help_workspace_read_token_budge: How much of one file read, or one tool result for the on-device model, reaches the model. The rest is cut, leaving room for the prompt.

app/strings_settings_search.xml.settings_search_desc_audio_max_duration_: Maximum voice capture before recording stops.
app/strings_settings_search.xml.settings_search_desc_auto_extract_enable: Learn durable facts from chats automatically.
app/strings_settings_search.xml.settings_search_desc_background_approval: How long a parked run waits for approval.
app/strings_settings_search.xml.settings_search_desc_block_destructive_t: Refuse destructive calls outright instead of asking.
app/strings_settings_search.xml.settings_search_desc_block_network_from_: Cloud models, memory search and Wikipedia off · Ollama only at a local IP.
app/strings_settings_search.xml.settings_search_desc_chat_history_compre: Summarise long threads past the live window.
Token budget above which history is compressed.
app/strings_settings_search.xml.settings_search_desc_chat_history_live_w: Recent messages kept verbatim when compressing.
app/strings_settings_search.xml.settings_search_desc_crash_reporting_ena: Opt-in · stack-trace only, no message content.
app/strings_settings_search.xml.settings_search_desc_default_pipeline_id: Set from the pipeline library — shown, not edited here.
app/strings_settings_search.xml.settings_search_desc_external_automation: Let Tasker, MacroDroid or adb start a run · off by default.
The one pipeline external automation is allowed to run.
app/strings_settings_search.xml.settings_search_desc_http_tool_max_respo: Largest web response or MCP result kept.
app/strings_settings_search.xml.settings_search_desc_identity: Anonymous · this device · keys in Keystore.
app/strings_settings_search.xml.settings_search_desc_language: Show the app in another language, or in the device's.
app/strings_settings_search.xml.settings_search_desc_link_backup_restore: Keep a copy, or move to a new phone.
app/strings_settings_search.xml.settings_search_desc_link_external_autom: Every inbound request, accepted or refused.
app/strings_settings_search.xml.settings_search_desc_link_provider_detai: Cloud retry settings live on Provider detail — link only.
app/strings_settings_search.xml.settings_search_desc_link_provider_list: Cloud API keys & retry stay on Provider detail.
app/strings_settings_search.xml.settings_search_desc_link_tools_screen: Enable/disable tools, risk overrides, MCP servers.
app/strings_settings_search.xml.settings_search_desc_max_context_length: Token window the model reads each turn.
app/strings_settings_search.xml.settings_search_desc_max_memory_chunks: Hard ceiling on the number of stored chunks.
app/strings_settings_search.xml.settings_search_desc_memory_actions: Back up, restore, re-embed or wipe memory.
app/strings_settings_search.xml.settings_search_desc_memory_compaction_a: Age after which a memory becomes a compaction candidate.
app/strings_settings_search.xml.settings_search_desc_memory_compaction_e: Merge & summarise old memories to save space.
app/strings_settings_search.xml.settings_search_desc_memory_recency_half: How fast older memories lose ranking weight.
app/strings_settings_search.xml.settings_search_desc_memory_search_thres: Minimum similarity score to surface a chunk.
app/strings_settings_search.xml.settings_search_desc_memory_search_top_k: How many chunks a single retrieval returns.
app/strings_settings_search.xml.settings_search_desc_quick_settings_tile: Pipeline run by the one-tap Quick Settings tile.
app/strings_settings_search.xml.settings_search_desc_reset: Restore defaults · keeps chats and memory.
app/strings_settings_search.xml.settings_search_desc_resume_max_age_hour: How long an interrupted run can still resume.
app/strings_settings_search.xml.settings_search_desc_scheduled_task_noti: Notify when a scheduled task fires.
app/strings_settings_search.xml.settings_search_desc_share_reuse_session: Add every share to a single Shared chat instead of a new one each time.
app/strings_settings_search.xml.settings_search_desc_share_target_pipeli: Pipeline run when you share text or an image into the app.
app/strings_settings_search.xml.settings_search_desc_structured_output_m: Retries to coerce malformed JSON output.
app/strings_settings_search.xml.settings_search_desc_system_prompt_prefi: Prepended to every system prompt the agent sends.
app/strings_settings_search.xml.settings_search_desc_temperature: Sampling randomness — higher is more creative.
app/strings_settings_search.xml.settings_search_desc_tool_approval_polic: When to pause for a human yes.
app/strings_settings_search.xml.settings_search_desc_tool_call_timeout_m: How long a run waits for your approval before parking.
app/strings_settings_search.xml.settings_search_desc_top_k: Sample only from the K most-likely tokens.
app/strings_settings_search.xml.settings_search_desc_trace_retention_max: Maximum age a run trace is kept.

app/strings_tool_descriptions.xml.tool_description_append_file: Appends UTF-8 text to the END of a file in the agent's private workspace, creating the file and parent directories if they do not exist. Existing content is always preserved (there is no overwrite). Use this to accumulate entries in a log or report; use write_file to create or replace a whole file, or edit_file to change part of one.
app/strings_tool_descriptions.xml.tool_description_delegate_task: Delegates a complex or specialized task to an external LLM and returns its answer. ONLY use this tool if you need cloud reasoning.
app/strings_tool_descriptions.xml.tool_description_delete_file: Deletes a single file from the agent's private workspace. This is irreversible and always requires the user to confirm before it runs. Only regular files can be deleted.
app/strings_tool_descriptions.xml.tool_description_edit_file: Edits an existing text file in the agent's private workspace by replacing the single occurrence of 'oldText' with 'newText'. The 'oldText' anchor must appear exactly once in the file — include enough surrounding context to make it unique, or the edit is refused. An empty 'newText' deletes the matched fragment. Use write_file to create a file or replace it wholesale.
app/strings_tool_descriptions.xml.tool_description_find_files: Finds files in the agent's private workspace whose relative path matches a glob pattern. Supports '*' (within one path segment), '**' (across directories) and '?'. Examples: '*.md', 'reports/**', '**/*.json'. Returns matching files with size and last-modified time.
app/strings_tool_descriptions.xml.tool_description_http_request: Performs an HTTP request to a remote API and returns the status, headers and (truncated) body. Supports GET, POST, PUT and DELETE. ONLY domains the user has explicitly added to the allowlist (Settings → Tools → Allowed domains) can be reached; any other host is refused. Public hosts must use https. Never put a stored API key in headers or body — such requests are refused. GET requires confirmation; POST/PUT/DELETE require an explicit destructive-action confirmation.
app/strings_tool_descriptions.xml.tool_description_list_files: Lists files in the agent's private workspace, one per line with size and last-modified time. Pass an optional 'path' to list only a sub-directory. Use this to discover what files exist before reading or writing them.
app/strings_tool_descriptions.xml.tool_description_read_file: Reads a UTF-8 text file from the agent's private workspace. Returns the file content, truncated to a token budget so long files do not overflow the context window. Use the byte 'offset' and 'limit' arguments to page through a long file: when the result ends with a '[... truncated, N bytes remain — use offset M to continue]' marker, call again with 'offset' set to the exact value M from that marker to read the next page.
app/strings_tool_descriptions.xml.tool_description_schedule_task: Schedules a task to be executed by the agent in the background. intervalHours: >0 for periodic, 0 for one-time. delayMinutes: >0 for delayed execution.
app/strings_tool_descriptions.xml.tool_description_search_tool: Searches Wikipedia for up-to-date information about a topic. Use this when you need facts or data to answer a user's question.
app/strings_tool_descriptions.xml.tool_description_write_file: Writes a UTF-8 text file to the agent's private workspace, creating parent directories as needed. Creating a new file is the default; to replace an existing file you must pass "overwrite": true (without it, writing over an existing file is refused so content is never clobbered by accident). Use edit_file for a small change to an existing file.

catalog/strings_node_types.xml.knotwork_node_type_intent_router_descrip: Sorts the incoming text into one of your classes and sends the run down its branch.
catalog/strings_node_types.xml.knotwork_node_type_lite_rt_description: One inference step on the local model running on the phone.
catalog/strings_node_types.xml.knotwork_node_type_output_description: Where the run ends and the answer reaches you.
catalog/strings_node_types.xml.knotwork_node_type_pipeline_description: Runs another saved pipeline as a single step and returns its answer.
catalog/strings_node_types.xml.knotwork_node_type_queue_processor_descr: Walks a list of subtasks one at a time down the Item branch, then the Done branch.
catalog/strings_node_types.xml.knotwork_node_type_skill_description: Runs a reusable skill: a fixed instruction plus the list of tools that skill may use.
catalog/strings_node_types.xml.knotwork_node_type_summary_description: Condenses what earlier steps produced into one piece of text, often after a loop.
catalog/strings_node_types.xml.knotwork_node_type_tool_description: Calls one tool, built-in or from another app or MCP server, and passes the result on.

catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_action_export_line: JSON · header, records, hashes, run digest
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_action_export_line_pre: JSON · records only, no seed or hashes
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_action_seed_line: Same seed and sampler; the answer repeats only if every input is the same.
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_action_verify_line_npu: %1$d calls ran on the NPU · none can be re-run
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_export_body: The file holds everything the model read in this run: prompts, memory excerpts, and the chat history inside those prompts. It stays on this device unless you share it.
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_hash_short_a11y: %1$s hash %2$s. Double-tap to copy the full SHA-256.
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_kept_note: Verify, Run again and Export work while this run is kept. How much run history stays is set in Settings → Privacy.
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_line_open_a11y: Run header, expanded. Double-tap to collapse.
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_line_pre_version: no run header · recorded before runs kept one
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_not_signed: Hashes show this export and a repeat match. They do not prove who produced it — nothing is signed.
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_nv_cloud: Answered by a cloud model · cannot be re-run here
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_nv_image: Read an image · not checked to repeat
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_nv_model_not_recorded: The model file had no SHA-256 yet · cannot be re-run
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_nv_npu: Ran on the NPU · not checked to repeat
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_nv_tool: Tool not run again · its recorded output stands
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_repro_cloud_body: This app cannot repeat a cloud model’s answer. The versions above still record what ran on this phone.
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_repro_cloud_head: Not promised: every answer came from a cloud model
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_repro_cpu: On CPU, with the same model file, seed, sampler and input.
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_repro_gpu: On GPU, with the same model file, seed, sampler, input and context window.
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_repro_head: Repeats byte for byte on this device
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_repro_head_mixed: On-device calls repeat byte for byte on this device
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_repro_image_body: Runs that read an image are not checked to repeat.
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_repro_image_head: Not promised: this run read an image
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_repro_limit: Not promised on the NPU, on another device or with another LiteRT-LM version.
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_repro_npu_body: Answers on the NPU are not checked to repeat. For runs that repeat, choose CPU or GPU in Settings.
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_repro_npu_head: Not promised: this run used the NPU
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_repro_pre_version: Recorded before the app kept seeds and hashes, so this run cannot be verified or repeated.
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_seed_confirm_body: A new run of “%1$s” on today’s inputs: memory, chat history and tool results are read again, and tools run again with the usual approvals.
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_seed_not_background: Not offered for runs a trigger started.
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_seed_not_image: Not offered for runs that read an image.
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_seed_not_pipeline_deleted: Not offered: the pipeline this run used was deleted.
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_seed_not_pre_version: Not offered: no seed was recorded.
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_sha_not_recorded: not recorded · the file had no SHA-256 yet
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_verify_all_body: Every on-device answer is byte for byte the one recorded.
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_verify_all_body_nv: %1$d nodes could not be verified; each says why.
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_verify_cancelled_body: The calls checked so far matched. The rest were not checked.
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_verify_confirm_body: Re-runs the on-device model %1$d times from the recorded prompts, with seed %2$s, and compares each answer byte for byte. Tools are not run again: their recorded output stands.
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_verify_confirm_busy: The on-device model is busy until it finishes. You can cancel.
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_verify_confirm_cloud: %1$d cloud calls are skipped: they cannot be verified.
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_verify_confirm_time: About %1$s — each call takes about as long as its node did.
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_verify_div_body: “%1$s” gave a different answer at call %2$d of %3$d. Each call is re-run from its own recorded prompt, so later nodes were checked on their own.
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_verify_failed_body: %1$s did not load (%2$s), so nothing was compared.
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_verify_failed_head: The on-device model could not load
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_verify_hash_pending: Available once the model file’s SHA-256 is computed.
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_verify_mismatch_backend: Recorded on %1$s; the app now runs on %2$s. To verify, choose %1$s in Settings.
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_verify_mismatch_both: Recorded on %1$s with a %2$s window; the app now runs on %3$s. To verify, choose %1$s in Settings and a %2$s window in Settings → Generation.
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_verify_mismatch_runtime: Recorded with %1$s; the app now runs %2$s. A run is verified only on the engine version that recorded it.
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_verify_mismatch_window: Recorded with a %1$s window; the app now uses %2$s. To verify, set %1$s in Settings → Generation.
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_verify_model_changed: The %1$s file on this device is not the one this run used: its SHA-256 differs.
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_verify_model_missing: %1$s, the model this run used, is no longer on this device. Download it again to verify.
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_verify_no_local: Nothing to re-run: no answer in this run came from the on-device model.
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_verify_none_body: No call in this run can be re-run and compared. Each node says why.
catalog/strings_runs.xml.knotwork_run_verify_pre_version: Not available: no seed was recorded.
